title: transfer_request (SPEC 17.3): what a gateway holds when it decides one transfer, before anything moves
description: The gateway assembles it from the parsed A2A or MCP call, the agent's identity, the mandate it holds for the agent, the deal the call names, the planned settlement and its own ledger of this chain. decide() answers with a gate_decision. Set by the gateway, never taken from the call: transfer, at, tool, aud, human_present, runtime_proof.peer_id, deal, mandate_end, settlement, history. From the agent: identity (its card), runtime_proof.sig, step_up. From the counterparty: counterparty_identity.

transfer.description: Minted by the gateway, one per attempt, never reused: the runtime proof and the step-up are bound to it.

at.description: The transfer time from the gateway's own clock, with a zone. Every time check runs against it.

tool.description: The A2A method or MCP tool that would move value; RBAC is on identity and this name.

aud.description: The gateway's own id; the key runtime proof is bound to it.

human_present.description: Asserted by the gateway when a person is in the loop for this transfer (for example a pay_url the principal opens). Never taken from the agent's call.

oneOf.description: Ed25519 by the identity's runtime key over canonical({ transfer, agent, aud, deal, amount_minor, currency }) (runtimeProofBody).

agreed_sha256.description: sha256hex(canonical(message)) of the A2A Message as sent, messageId included, whose Task is task_id; for a PazAIr order, of the order input as sent.

ref.description: ls_… for a listing, the award hash for an award, the checkout or order id for UCP and ACP.

hash.description: sha256hex(canonical(deal object as served)): the listing, the signed award, the UCP checkout, the ACP checkout session, or the x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED body. The gateway fetched and hashed it; the agent cannot assert it.

output_schema_sha256.description: The delivery contract (SPEC: output_schema), hashed. One of output_schema_sha256 or terms_sha256 is required: no free text as a contract.

terms_sha256.description: Machine-readable terms other than an output_schema: for x402, the hash of resource and description of the requirements; for UCP/ACP, the hash of the line items and totals.

step_up.description: A step_up object when the mandate asks for one.

fee_minor.description: The rail's fee for this transfer. Above max_fee_ratio of the amount it is a defect (FEE_EATS_CALL).

asset.description: Required when currency differs from the deal's: the asset settled (usdc, rlusd, xlm), as CAIP-19 where one exists.

network.description: CAIP-2 network for x402, xrpl, stellar (eip155:8453, xrpl:0, stellar:pubnet).

rate.description: settlement minor units per deal minor unit; settlement.amount_minor must equal round(deal.amount_minor × rate) within 1.

fx.description: Required when the settlement asset is not the deal's currency (DEAL_FX_MISSING).

history.description: The gateway's own ledger: every transfer of this mandate it allowed (a reservation) or settled, with the chain it belongs to. The monthly cap counts every entry of the month in the mandate's currency; the evidence rule looks at settled entries (settlement_id set) of this chain, or without chain. Not a list of valid entries: REQUEST_HISTORY_INVALID.

chain.description: Optional: the chain this entry belongs to (sha256hex("<mandate hash>:<seller>")). Entries of another chain count for the monthly cap but not for the evidence rule; an entry without chain counts for both.
